name: Full Tilt (Tempest Wall Free Version)
approach: From the Stuart Lake Trailhead (FS Road 7601 off Icicle Creek Road), take the Colchuck Lake Trail (#1599) to Colchuck Lake — 4 miles, 2,280 ft gain, a log-bridge crossing of Mountaineer Creek at 1.5 miles, staying right at the Lake Stuart Trail junction, then a boulder-moraine finish to the outlet (2.5-3 hours, last water). Continue toward the lake's south/east side onto the cairned Aasgard Pass climbers' trail, gaining talus/heather to about 400 ft above the lake (30-40 min, holds wet snow into July), then cut climber's-left through dense slide-alder/heather brush (15-20 minutes) to the base gully below Colchuck Balanced Rock. Full Tilt — the free version of the Tempest Wall's aid line(s) — starts a few hundred feet down the gully to the right of the West Face's start, on Grade III terrain. Expect loose 3rd/4th-class rock in the final scramble to the wall.
